name: perego-theme/hero-slider
title: Perego Hero Slider
description: The homepage hero: a rotating set of headline slides with dot tabs, prev/next and pause/play controls, an aria-live announcer, and a CTA. Auto-advances (6.5s), pauses on hover and when the tab is hidden, and never auto-advances under reduced motion. Server-rendered; interactivity via view.js.
